questions.question: What is the prayer at the start of Psalm 67?
options: That God would be gracious and make his face shine on us
That God would send down the refreshing rain upon the land
That God would firmly establish the throne of the king
That God would scatter the proud and the mighty of the earth
questions.answer: That God would be gracious and make his face shine on us

questions.question: What does the psalm desire for the nations?
options: That all peoples praise God and the nations be glad
That the harvest be rich and the barns be full
That the king reign in peace for many years
That Israel alone be honored above the nations
questions.answer: That all peoples praise God and the nations be glad

questions.question: The psalm says the earth has yielded its increase, and God shall bless us.
Let the peoples _____ you, O God; let all the peoples praise you!
God shall bless us; let all the ends of the _____ fear him!
